blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is designed to support flexible representation sizes by jointly optimizing nested prefixes. While effective, this design lacks an explicit constraint to ensure that the leading portion provides a suitable compact encoding. To address this, we propose SpecMRL, which reorganizes the feature space to enable more effective prefix readout. Specifically, we extend MRL with a parameter-derived spectral basis organized with feature importance. SpecMRL otherwise follows standard MRL, with prefix readout performed in the learned spectral space. Experiments on MTEB show that SpecMRL outperforms MRL at all evaluated reduced dimensions, with larger gains under more aggressive compression. These results suggest that the learned spectral basis better prioritizes informative directions, enabling more effective representation compression. Notably, SpecMRL extends the performance frontier of MRL, surpassing full-dimensional MRL with only half the embedding dimensions.
blocks.zh: Matryoshka代表学习(MRL)旨在通过共同优化嵌入前缀来支持灵活的代表大小. 这种设计虽然有效,但缺乏明确的制约,无法确保主导部分提供合适的紧凑编码. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出"SpecMRL"(SpecMRL),它重组了特征空间,以便能更有效地读取前缀. 具体地说,我们扩展了MRL,以一个参数衍生的光谱基础,它具有特征重要性。 SpecMRL否则会遵循标准的MRL,在所学光谱空间进行前缀读出. 关于MTEB的实验显示,SpecMRL的性能完全超过MRL评价被降低的维度,在更积极的压缩下获得更大的收益. 这些结果表明,所学光谱基础更好地确定信息化方向的优先次序,从而能够更有效地进行表达压缩。 值得注意的是,SpecMRL扩展了MRL的性能前沿,超过了全维的MRL,而嵌入维度只有一半.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Representation learning has been a well-established research topic in the ML community ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Gao et al., 2021b ) and underpins a wide range of downstream applications ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ; Karpukhin et al., 2020 ) .
The growing applications call for more flexible representation schemes that can adapt to varying latency and storage constraints across use cases.
Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL, Kusupati et al., 2022 ) was introduced to address this need, offering an approach that can be easily adopted in existing representation learning frameworks.
blocks.zh:
代表性学习在ML社区一直是一个公认的研究课题(Chen等人,2020年;Gao等人,2021年b),并支撑了广泛的下游应用(Reimers and Gurevich,2019年;Karpukhin等人,2020年).
越来越多的申请要求采用更灵活的代表性方案,以适应不同使用情况下的延迟和储存限制。
为满足这一需要,引入了Matryoshka代表学习(MRL、Kusupati等人,2022年),提供了一种在现有代表学习框架中易于采用的方法。

blocks.en:
The central idea of MRL is to extend full-dimensional representation learning to a set of nested prefixes.
In practice, each nested readout is constructed from the leading portion of the full representation.
This design enables representations at multiple output dimensions to be learned within a single training run.
While simple and effective, it does not explicitly ensure that earlier dimensions are better suited for nested readout, motivating a more principled design for MRL.
blocks.zh:
MRL的中心思想是将全维的表达学习扩展到一组嵌套前缀.
在实际操作中,每个嵌套读数都是从全代表的领先部分构建的.
这种设计使多种产出层面的表述能够在单一的训练中学习。
它虽然简单而有效,但并未明确确保较早的维度更适合嵌入式读取,从而促使MRL有一个更原则性的设计.

blocks.en:
For such prefix readout to be effective, the leading dimensions should ideally concentrate the information most useful for compact representations.
However, standard MRL provides no explicit constraint for establishing this ordering.
Earlier studies ( LI et al., 2025 ; Huy et al., 2026 ) have sought to improve low-dimensional readouts through cross-dimensional supervision.
Yet, these approaches keep the original coordinate system unchanged, which may itself be ill-suited to effective prefix truncation.
Figure 1 depicts how a more suitable basis can better organize semantic information and improve the quality of low-dimensional representations.
This motivates us to rethink how the representation space itself should be organized to better support nested prefix readout in MRL.
blocks.zh:
为了使这种前缀读出有效,主要层面最好集中最有助于紧凑表述的信息。
然而,标准MRL没有为确定这一命令提供明确的限制。
早期的研究(LI等人,2025年;Huy等人,2026年)试图通过跨维监督改进低维读取.
然而,这些方法使原来的坐标系统保持不变,这本身可能不适合有效的前缀截断.
图1描绘了更合适的基础如何能够更好地组织语义信息,提高低维表达的质量.
这促使我们重新思考如何组织代表空间本身,以便更好地支持在MRL中嵌入式前缀读出.

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose SpecMRL, a parameter-derived spectral redesign of MRL that organizes the representation space by feature importance.
Such an organization better aligns with the prefix-based design of MRL and provides a natural foundation for dimension reduction.
Starting from a backbone representation, SpecMRL differs from standard MRL only in its choice of basis.
Figure 1 presents a comparative overview of MRL and SpecMRL, highlighting different organizations of representation space for nested readout.
Specifically, SpecMRL changes only the representation basis, with standard MRL subsequently applied in the resulting space.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提议对SpecMRL进行基于参数的光谱重新设计,按特征重要性来组织表示空间。
这种组织更好地与基于MRL的前缀设计保持一致,并为维度的降低提供了自然的基础.
从骨干代表开始,SpecMRL仅在基础选择上与标准MRL不同.
图1对MRL和SpecMRL进行了比较性概述,重点介绍了巢读出的不同代表空间组织.
具体来说,SpecMRL只改变表示基础,标准MRL随后被应用到由此产生的空间中.

blocks.en:
Concretely, we introduce a matrix 𝑾 Proj {\bm{W}}_{\mathrm{Proj}} and derive from its Gram matrix an ordered spectral basis that serves as the desired coordinate system.
Although this is simple in design, a direct implementation poses two challenges: (1) the computational overhead of standard eigen solvers and (2) the numerical instability of eigen vector gradients.
To address these challenges, we introduce several technical refinements and develop a power-iteration-based alternative to approximate the eigen decomposition of the Gram matrix.
Our empirical observations further confirm that this design avoids training collapse due to numerical instability while achieving throughput comparable to vanilla MRL.

具体来说,我们引入了矩阵W Proj {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}从它的格莱姆矩阵中得出一个光谱基础 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}作为想要的坐标系统
虽然这在设计上很简单,但直接执行带来了两个挑战:(1)标准eigen解析器的计算间接费用和(2)eigen矢量梯度的数值不稳定.
为了应对这些挑战,我们进行了一些技术改进,并开发了一种基于动力的替代方法,以接近格拉姆矩阵的精度分解。
我们的经验观察进一步证实,这种设计避免了由于数字不稳定而导致培训崩溃,同时实现了与香草MRL类似的吞吐量.

blocks.en:
We conduct experiments to validate the effectiveness of SpecMRL and provide further insights into its design.
Specifically, we evaluate SpecMRL on widely used MTEB datasets ( Muennighoff et al., 2022 ) with backbones from multiple model families.
The empirical results show that SpecMRL substantially improves performance at reduced dimensions, outperforming MRL by up to 3.80 points under 16 × 16\times compression.
Beyond these gains, SpecMRL further extends the performance frontier of MRL, surpassing its full-capacity performance with only half the dimensions.
Further validation shows that these gains persist with larger backbones and longer training, confirming the potential of its further scaling.
Our analyses also provide initial insights into why SpecMRL is effective.
Taken together, these results motivate a rethink of the design principles of MRL and we hope it can inspire improvements for future representation learning.
blocks.zh:
我们进行实验,以验证SpecMRL的有效性,并进一步深入了解其设计。
具体来说,我们用来自多个模范家庭的骨干对广泛使用的MTEB数据集(Muennighoff等人,2022年)进行SpecMRL评价.
实证结果显示,SpecMRL在缩小维度时会大幅提高性能,比MRL的性能在16×16\times压缩下达到3.80分.
除了这些收益外,SpecMRL还进一步扩大了MRL的性能前沿,仅以一半的维度超过了其全能性能.
进一步验证表明,这些成果继续存在,需要更大的骨干力量和更长的培训,这证实了进一步推广的潜力。
我们的分析还初步揭示了SpecMRL为什么有效。
这些结果加在一起,促使人们重新思考管理、劳改和调解权的设计原则,我们希望它能够激励改进今后的代表学习。

blocks.en: 2 Background: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL)
blocks.zh: 2 背景: Matryoshka 代表性学习

blocks.en:
We briefly review how sentence embeddings are obtained and trained with LLMs before the introduction of MRL ( Kusupati et al., 2022 ) .
Given an input sequence 𝒔 {\bm{s}} , the LLM encodes it into contextualized hidden states and aggregates them into a dense representation 𝑿 {\bm{X}} : 𝑿 = 𝐏 ⁡ ( LLM ⁡ ( [ 𝒔 1 , 𝒔 2 , … , 𝒔 n ] ) ) . {\bm{X}}=\mathcal{\mathbf{P}}\left(\operatorname{\mathrm{LLM}}\left([{\bm{s}}_{1},{\bm{s}}_{2},\dots,{\bm{s}}_{n}]\right)\right). Given a training batch ℬ \mathcal{B} , 𝑿 {\bm{X}} is typically optimized via the following contrastive loss: ℒ ( 𝑿 ) = − 1 | ℬ | ∑ 𝑿 ∈ ℬ log exp ⁡ ( sim ⁡ ( 𝑿 , 𝑿 + , T ) ) exp ⁡ ( sim ⁡ ( 𝑿 , 𝑿 + , T ) ) + ∑ 𝑿 − ∈ 𝒩 exp ⁡ ( sim ⁡ ( 𝑿 , 𝑿 − , T ) ) , \mathcal{L}\left({\bm{X}}\right)=-\frac{1}{|\mathcal{B}|}\sum_{{\bm{X}}\in\mathcal{B}}\log\frac{\exp\big(\operatorname{sim}({\bm{X}},{\bm{X}}^{+};T)\big)}{\exp\big(\operatorname{sim}({\bm{X}},{\bm{X}}^{+};T)\big)+\sum_{{\bm{X}}^{-}\in\mathcal{N}}\exp\big(\operatorname{sim}({\bm{X}},{\bm{X}}^{-};T)\big)}, (1) where 𝑿 + {\bm{X}}^{+} and 𝑿 − {\bm{X}}^{-} denote the positive and negative samples of 𝑿 {\bm{X}} , and T T controls the temperature of the similarity function sim ⁡ ( ⋅ , ⋅ , T ) \operatorname{sim}(\cdot,\cdot\,;\,T) .
MRL extends this contrastive learning over a set of nested dimensions ℳ \mathcal{M} , with loss applied at each dimension.
Specifically, for any nested dimension m ∈ ℳ m\in\mathcal{M} , MRL retains the first m m entries of 𝑿 {\bm{X}} as the reduced representation: 𝑿 MRL ( m ) = 𝑿 [ : , : m ] , {\bm{X}}_{\textrm{MRL}}^{(m)}\,=\,{\bm{X}}[:\,,\,:m], (2) and aggregates the losses across nested dimensions into a weighted objective: ℒ MRL = ∑ m ∈ ℳ w m ​ ℒ ​ ( 𝑿 MRL ( m ) ) , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MRL}}\;=\;\sum\nolimits_{m\in\mathcal{M}}w_{m}\,\mathcal{L}\left({\bm{X}}^{(m)}_{\textrm{MRL}}\right)\;, (3) where w m w_{m} denotes the weight assigned to each dimension m m .
This nested structure motivates the name, M atryoshka R epresentation L earning ( MRL ).
Here, the “Matryoshka” metaphor is motivated by Russian nesting dolls, reflecting the intuition that more informative features should occupy earlier dimensions.
Despite this motivation, MRL does not explicitly ensure such an ordering, leaving the distribution of information across dimensions unspecified.
Prior work ( LI et al., 2025 ; Yang and Zhao, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) has also considered this issue, but mainly introduces additional constraints across nested representations instead of directly ordering the feature dimensions.
In this paper, we seek to establish refined design principles toward better dimension reduction.
Below, we present SpecMRL as a refined perspective on how the core motivation behind MRL can be realized.

blocks.en: 3.2 SpecMRL with Efficient and Scalable Spectral Solver
blocks.zh: 3.2 带高效和可伸缩光谱溶剂的光谱MRL

blocks.en:
While SpecMRL is simple in design, its naive implementation can involve several subtle technical challenges that are easy to overlook.
A straightforward approach is to directly decompose the Gram matrix using off-the-shelf numerical tools, such as the built-in eigen solvers in PyTorch ( Paszke et al., 2019 ) , to obtain the spectral basis.
However, this is (1) computationally expensive and (2) sensitive to ill-conditioned eigenvalue distribution, making it unsuitable in practice. 2 2 2 For readers unfamiliar with this issue, we provide a detailed discussion in Section 4.1.3 .
blocks.zh:

Gradients propagate through the Gram matrix and QR factorization, while basis 𝑼 ( t − 1 ) {\bm{U}}^{(t-1)} is held fixed.

The benefits of our power iteration design are empirically validated in practice.
In particular, our power-iteration design avoids training collapse across all experimental settings with only modest computational overhead.

Eigen decomposition organizes the learned structure into an ordered set of orthogonal directions.
This suggests two possible sources of improvement: learning a favorable orthogonal basis and imposing a spectral ordering.
To disentangle their effects, we construct an ablated variant that retains only learnable orthogonality.
This allows us to assess whether the learned spectral ordering benefits MRL’s nested readouts.
Specifically, we replace the orthogonal basis in Eq. 4 as: 𝑼 Orth = 𝐐𝐑 ⁡ ( 𝑾 Proj ​ 𝑾 Proj ⊤ ) , {\bm{U}}_{\mathrm{Orth}}\,=\,\operatorname{\mathbf{QR}}\!\left(\,{\bm{W}}_{\mathrm{Proj}}\,{\bm{W}}_{\mathrm{Proj}}^{\top}\,\right), (11) where QR is applied to the Gram matrix alone to retain orthogonality. Table 5 (b) reports its results.
Compared with vanilla MRL, learned orthogonality provides a clear advantage, but remains inferior to the full SpecMRL design.
This further highlights the value of ordering feature directions by learned importance, which is naturally compatible with MRL’s nested readout design.

为了解开它们的效应,我们构建了一个只保留可学习的矫形的减速变体.

Both ESE and MIPIC are designed to enhance information retention at lower dimensions through additional supervision.
Specifically, they augment the standard MRL objective with different loss designs for cross-dimensional supervision.

We further evaluate SpecMRL under different MRL settings to assess whether its advantages are robust across configurations.
Specifically, we conduct two experiments on Qwen3-0.6B: (1) setting all nested loss weights to 1 1 , and (2) adopting sparse supervision by dropping the last two dimensions ( 128 128 and 64 64 ) from the nested training set.

This suggests that SpecMRL depends less on direct supervision at individual prefixes to preserve low-dimensional information, enabling effective readout under sparser nested supervision and demonstrating robustness to the choice of training dimensions.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Modern applications use models to encode data into embeddings for a wide range of downstream tasks.
Despite continued improvements in quality, the storage and computational costs of fixed, high-dimensional embeddings remain a practical bottleneck. MRL ( Kusupati et al., 2022 ) addresses this limitation through joint supervision of nested prefixes, enabling flexible output dimensions.
While MRL is simple, several methods seek further improvements by introducing auxiliary objectives.
ESE ( LI et al., 2025 ) introduces a learn-to-compress (L2C) objective that supervises truncated prefixes with PCA-based compression targets.
Similarly, MIPIC ( Huy et al., 2026 ) aligns token-level relations across dimensions through self-distilled intra-relational alignment (SIA), matching token-importance distributions with KL divergence and inter-token geometry with centered kernel alignment.
Both methods derive alignment targets from full-dimensional embeddings to supervise low-dimensional prefixes, while also incorporating intermediate-layer supervision to improve embeddings at shallower depths.
In contrast to alignment-based supervision, MIC ( Hong et al., 2026 ) introduces geometric regularization to reduce redundancy between prefix and residual dimensions.
blocks.zh:
现代应用使用模型将数据编码成嵌入,用于广泛的下游任务.
尽管质量持续改善,但固定高维嵌入的存储和计算成本仍然是一个实际瓶颈。 MRL(Kusupati等人,2022年)通过对嵌套前缀进行联合监管来解决这一限制,使输出维度具有弹性.
虽然MRL很简单,但有几种方法通过引入辅助目标来寻求进一步的改进.
ESE(LI 等人,2025年)引入了学习到压缩(L2C)目标,对带有基于PCA的压缩目标的截断前缀进行监督.
同样,MIPIC(Huy et al., 2026)通过自定的相互关系内部对齐(SIA),将象征-进口分布与KL差异相匹配,以及以内核为中心对齐的孔间几何等来协调不同维度的符号级关系.
这两种方法都从全维嵌入物中衍生出对齐目标,以监督低维前缀,同时结合中间层监理,在更浅的深度改进嵌入物.
相对于基于对齐的监管,MIC(Hong et al., 2026)引入几何规范,以减少前缀和剩余维度之间的冗余.

blocks.en:
MRL has also been extended to frozen models by adding lightweight trainable layers, supporting effective prefix truncation at multiple dimensions without backbone update.
Following this idea,
Matryoshka-Adaptor ( Yoon et al., 2024 ) learns nested embeddings through lightweight adapters, while SMEC ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) further improves this adaptation process through sequential training and adaptive dimension selection.
More recently, AdaWidth ( Yang and Zhao, 2026 ) learns an orthogonal rotation of frozen embeddings, providing a learnable orthogonal basis without explicit spectral ordering. This design is conceptually closely related to the learnable-basis ablation considered in our analysis, which underperforms the proposed spectral basis.
blocks.zh:
MRL也通过添加轻量级可列车层,支持有效的多维前缀切换而无需主干线更新而扩展至冷冻型号.
根据这个想法,
Matryoshka-Adaptor(Yoon等人,2024年)通过轻量级适配器学习嵌入,而SMEC(Zhang等人,2025年)则通过顺序培训和适应维度选择来进一步改善这一适应过程.
最近,AdaWidth(Yang and Zhao, 2026)学习冷冻嵌入物的正交旋转,在没有明确光谱命令的情况下提供可学习的正交基础. 这种设计在概念上与我们的分析中考虑的可学习基础衰减密切相关,它没有很好地落实拟议的光谱基础。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We present SpecMRL, a parametric-spectral redesign of MRL that addresses the limitations of fixed basis-prefix readout.
By exploiting the ordered orthogonal structure of the learned spectrum, SpecMRL reorganizes representations into a form naturally suited to nested truncation.
Across diverse experimental settings, SpecMRL consistently outperforms MRL at reduced dimensions with negligible overhead, while further extending the performance frontier.
These findings highlight the readout space as an important learning target in nested representation. We hope this perspective motivates further exploration of information organization and inspires more principled MRL designs.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍SpecMRL,这是对MRL的参数-光谱重新设计,它解决了固定基位前缀读取的局限性.
SpecMRL通过利用所学光谱的有序正交结构,将代表物重组为自然适合嵌入断流的形式.
在整个不同的实验环境中,SpecMRL在降低维度,可忽略不计的间接费用上,一贯优于MRL,同时进一步扩展性能前沿.
这些结论突出了读取空间是嵌入式代表的重要学习目标. 我们希望这一视角能激发对信息组织的进一步探索,激励更具原则性的MRL设计.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 shows that the final band accounts for a large fraction of energy (21.72%), despite spanning only 5% of the spectral directions.
Ideally, the energy should decay smoothly across the ordered spectral bands, with the first band accounting for the largest share, consistent with its intended role in capturing the most informative semantic directions in MRL.
The decay pattern reflects the decreasing semantic importance of later spectral bands, while the smoothness helps maintain isotropy by avoiding concentration in a small subset of directions.
In turn, the disproportionate concentration in the final band indicates increased anisotropy, suggesting a departure from the expected geometry.
Similar observations have also been reported by Wu et al. (2026) .
Although the cause of this phenomenon remains unclear, we hope this analysis provides an initial explanation for the observed improvement and motivates further investigation.
